name: manual_418e74
claim: GUARD_SYNC_SKIP_DIVERGENCE_CHECK=1 is a documented, purpose-built escape hatch for the guard-sync-divergence pre-push hook — use it scoped to one push, only after concretely proving the flagged sibling isn't a real git repo, never as a habitual bypass

decisions.notes: Distinct from --no-verify: this skips one specific, provably-false-positive check while leaving every other guard (attribution scan, banned-token scan) active. Used once on PT PR #355's push after confirming the flagged sdists-v9 sibling was a 0-byte non-git marker file, not skipped preemptively or by default.
